text:
Rhea: Heads up — morning spend spike burned through our pacing. Propose daypart caps + small holdback to validate new creative rotation. Can someone stand up today?

Leo: I can. Suggest bids -20% 9-12PT, +10% 18-21PT. Holdback 15% traffic.

Sam: agree. need to confirm gclid forwarding and UTM naming before go-live. last test lost ~25% due to mapping mismatch.

AdOps Bot: hourly-report.csv uploaded -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/hourly/234567. AM CTR -0.6%, CPC +8%.

Priya: I'll upload two headline sets and a stat-led variant. filenames: daypart_head_A.jpg, daypart_head_B.jpg, lp_stat.html.

Leo: adding negative match on "free" and "download". keyword set: `llm serving`, `inference platform`, `inference latency`.

Sam: test curl to validate webhook: curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"gclid":"test-gclid","utm_campaign":"q2_daypart","creative":"headlineB"}'

Rhea: SLA: webhook must return 200 < 400ms or retry route. Conversion lookback = 30d.

Leo: deploying canary now. canary = 12h at 20% spend. scale rules: only if CTR >= +5% and CPL <= -10%.

Sam: analytics will create cohorts (daypart_holdback, daypart_exposed) and dashboard tiles for CTR, CPC, CPL, SQL rate. alert if CPL +20% vs baseline for 2 windows.

Priya: assets uploaded to drive and linked in the campaign.

Leo: canary live. ping when gclid test passes. :rocket:

Sam: curl returned 200, gclid visible in test stream.

Rhea: monitoring first 3h. update here with short notes only. :eyes:
